summary: Ephemeral admin query whitelist for cross-team data reconciliation (timeboxed access request)
description: Issue summary: Request from Billing/CS to run targeted reconciliation queries against production inference logs to resolve a set of mismatched billing events. Requestor: Finance (L. Moreno) via CS triage. Justification: Discrepancies affecting 12 enterprise invoices for February; customer-impacting and requires matching request/response traces to billing ledger entries. Data scope: 48-hour window (2026-02-25 to 2026-02-26), token-level inference logs (request metadata, timestamps, cost fields), NO full customer payload dumps to leave raw prompt text out of the extract. Access duration requested: 72 hours (timeboxed). Proposed access pattern: temporary read-only IAM role bound to a query whitelist that only permits a set of pre-approved log queries; results must be redacted of PII and reviewed via SRE+Compliance before export. Audit requirements: enable session-level audit, notify #sec-access channel, and generate a tamper-evident extract manifest. Approval path requested: SRE -> Compliance -> CISO. Deliverables: sanitized CSV of matched event ids, query definitions, audit manifest, and deletion confirmation after 72 hours.
steps_to_execute: 1) Create temporary role 'ephemeral/recon/INT-904213' with read-only access to log-index namespace
2) Register query whitelist in query-gate service (queries attached in Confluence)
3) Enable audit-hook (write all query invocations to sealed-audit-bucket) and sampling flag
4) Run queries interactively with SRE observing in session; produce redacted output in staging bucket
5) Compliance performs redaction verification and signs manifest
6) Revoke role and delete staging bucket after confirmation
comments: 2026-03-11 09:18 - Aisha Patel: Opening request after Finance escalated via CS. Attached: invoice list and initial mismatch sample. Requesting SRE + Compliance review for timeboxed production log access.

2026-03-11 11:03 - Marcus Liu (SRE): Can we narrow the query to event IDs rather than token-level exports? Need exact query definitions to evaluate performance impact. Also asking for a safe sampling plan.

2026-03-11 14:22 - Nora Kim (Compliance): High-level okay if redaction is verifiable. Please include the redaction script and verification steps in the runbook. Compliance requires 2-person review for any export containing customer identifiers.

2026-03-12 08:45 - Marcus Liu (SRE): Uploaded proposed whitelist queries to Confluence runbook. Performance estimate: a full token-level scan across the 48-hour window may run ~30-45 min with current indices in us-east; I recommend a batched approach with limiting by event_id list.

2026-03-12 10:00 - Ben Thompson (Security): Recommend using ephemeral bastion role and JIT access tied to Okta approval. Also adding requirement: all exported files encrypted with customer-managed KMS key policy and S3 object lock disabled until compliance sign-off.

2026-03-13 16:05 - Nora Kim (Compliance): Reviewed redaction script version v1.2 and sample outputs. Verified PII patterns removed for a 1k-row sample. Pending final SRE confirmation and CISO approval for timebox length.
investigation_notes: Verified affected invoice ids from Finance ticket FIN-1123 match request timestamps in prod logs
Ran a dry-run with synthetic keys in staging to validate query syntax and index usage
Identified potential noisy scan on 'kv_cache' index; changed query plan to use 'event_time' partitioning to reduce load
Redaction script uses regex-based masking for emails and full-string hashing for phone numbers; retention of hashed IDs logged to audit manifest
risk_assessment: Medium: access limited to targeted queries, timeboxed, and requires two-person compliance verification. Residual risk: accidental inclusion of customer prompt text if query selector too broad. Mitigation: pre-run dry-run, automated redaction, and SRE observation during execution.
resolution: Pending approvals. SRE has prepared execution plan and whitelist queries. Compliance has approved redaction approach conditionally. CISO approval required for final sign-off and role creation. If approved, schedule execution window and notify #sec-access. Post-action: delete staging artifacts and publish audit manifest to Confluence.
follow_up_actions: CISO decision and Okta JIT workflow enablement (owner: CISO)
Post-execution: Compliance to publish verification note and delete artifacts (owner: Compliance)
Create a templated runbook for future reconciliations to reduce manual approval time (owner: SRE)
